title: 第3章 仙缘第4章 感知天地灵气
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
足足步行了有一刻钟的时间，三人终于来到了天煞帮的一处僻静角落。
这里临山，有一处独立的院落。
院落的四周有过百名携带钢刀弓弩的护卫守护。这些守卫面容冰冷，身形高大，给人一种无形中的巨大压迫感。
进入院落之后，入眼的是一排排的厢房。
在厢房的后方，山脚的位置有一幢独立的两层小楼。
小楼的四周被开辟出来，划分为一块块错落有致的田地，里面种植着一些不知名的草药。
一名壮汉指着厢房，用命令的语气说道。
“你随便找一间无人的房间住吧，每日三餐有人送饭，在没有人叫你出来前，禁止走出厢房。”
话落，壮汉神情冷漠的注视着宋文，仿佛是在催促宋文，赶快去选房间。
宋文随意的挑选了一间空房间，便走了进去。
房间之中有一套桌椅，一张床铺，床上铺着被褥，桌上放着茶壶。整个房间之中，便别无他物。
宋文将房间打量一番后，转身关上房门。
在他关上房门之时，趁机打量的屋外的情景，
两名壮汉已经离开院落，院落之外有重兵把守，他们并不担忧宋文可能会做出某些出格的事情。
关上房门后，宋文的神情变得狰狞和愤怒起来。
方才，他一直在压制心中的怒火。
天煞帮的强势和自己弱小，让他心中充满了憋屈和仇恨。
在这一刻，宋文心中充满对力量的渴望。
昨日，他在茶馆外乞食时，从食客的议论中得知，此方世界是有飞檐走壁的武者的。
他此时无比期望自己是一名拥有强大武力的侠客，能将整个天煞帮杀个对穿。

宋文被关在房间之中，一关就被关了七日时间。
前两日时间，对于天煞帮的强势和蛮横，宋文心中充满愤恨。
这种人为刀俎，我为鱼肉，让人完全无法反抗的感觉真的很糟糕。
不过还好，每日饭点有人准时送饭，伙食还不差，有菜有肉。
渡过前两日时间后，宋文的心思逐渐平静下来。
到最后两日时间，宋文也想明白了，被关在房间中禁止外出，估计是天煞帮有意为之，就是为了磨灭他们内心中的反抗情绪，让他们认清现实。
第八日，宋文终于听到门外有人大喊。
“所有人，即刻出房间。动作拖延者，将受到严厉处罚。”
随即，周边传来连续开门之声。
宋文也打开房门，走了出去。
入眼便看到厢房前的院落中，已经零零散散的站着百名左右十几岁的年轻人，在远处还站着十余名带刀的天煞帮帮众。
这些年轻人三五成群聚集在一起，显然他们和宋文一样，基本都是被胁迫至此，很多人都在低声的诉说的自己的不满。
这些年轻人都是盐城当地人，知晓天煞帮的强势，虽然他们心中充满了愤怒和不甘，但都只能小声对着护卫指指点点，敢怒不敢言。
其中有一名衣着华丽的小胖子，在一众大多出身清贫、身形消瘦的年轻人之中，显得尤为鹤立鸡群。
小胖子愤怒的咆哮道。
“你们天煞帮好大的胆子，竟敢绑架小爷我，家父张二河，乃是清原县县丞，你们还不快把我送回去！”
他驳斥的声音很大，吸引了在场所有人的目光。
宋文的视线也被小胖子吸引。
清原县是盐城下属的一座县城，距离盐城仅有百十里地。
在乾国，一县县丞的权利还是很大的。

宋文好奇，天煞帮要怎么处理这个小胖子。
到底是小胖子是地主家的傻儿子，看不清现实；还是天煞帮失误，踢到了铁板。
护卫们闻言，眼中虽也有迟疑之色，却也毫不为所动。他们显然已经不是第一次听小胖子提及自己身份。但对如何处理小胖子，护卫也觉得有几分棘手。
就在此时，一道人影从护卫们身后走出。
来人约莫四十来岁，身材消瘦，嘴上留着一抹八字胡。
content_en:
After walking for a quarter of an hour, the three finally arrived at a secluded corner of the Tiansha Gang.
There is an independent courtyard here near the mountain.
The courtyard is surrounded by over a hundred guards armed with steel swords, bows and crossbows. These guards have cold faces and tall bodies, giving people an invisible sense of oppression.
After entering the courtyard, the first thing you see is rows of wing rooms.
Behind the wing, there is an independent two-story building at the foot of the mountain.
The surroundings of the small building were opened up and divided into scattered fields, in which some unknown herbs were planted.
A strong man pointed to the wing and said in a commanding tone.
"You can just find an unoccupied room to live in. Someone will serve you three meals a day. You are not allowed to leave the wing until someone asks you to come out."
After finishing speaking, the strong man stared at Song Wen with an indifferent expression, as if urging Song Wen to quickly choose a room.
Song Wen randomly picked an empty room and walked in.
There is a set of tables and chairs in the room, a bed with quilts on it, and a teapot on the table. There was nothing else in the entire room.
After Song Wen looked around the room, he turned around and closed the door.
When he closed the door, he took the opportunity to look at the scene outside.
The two strong men had already left the courtyard, which was heavily guarded by soldiers. They were not worried that Song Wen might do something outrageous.
After closing the door, Song Wen's expression became ferocious and angry.
Just now, he had been suppressing the anger in his heart.
The strength of the Tiansha Gang and his own weakness filled his heart with frustration and hatred.
At this moment, Song Wen's heart was filled with desire for power.
Yesterday, when he was begging for food outside the teahouse, he learned from the comments of the diners that there were warriors in this world who could fly over the walls.
At this time, he extremely hoped that he would be a knight with powerful force and be able to kill the entire Tiansha Gang.
Song Wen was locked in a room for seven days.
In the past two days, Song Wen was filled with resentment for the Tiansha Gang's strength and arrogance.
This kind of feeling that people are being treated as slaves and I am being treated as fish and meat, which makes people completely unable to resist, is really terrible.
But fortunately, someone delivers meals on time every day. The food is not bad, with vegetables and meat.
After spending the first two days, Song Wen's mind gradually calmed down.
In the last two days, Song Wen also figured out that being locked in a room and forbidden to go out was probably intentional by the Tiansha Gang, in order to wipe out the resistance in their hearts and let them recognize the reality.
On the eighth day, Song Wen finally heard someone shouting outside the door.
"Everyone, please leave the room immediately. Those who delay will be severely punished."
Immediately, the sound of doors opening continuously came from the surrounding area.
Song Wen also opened the door and walked out.
As soon as he saw it, he saw about a hundred young people in their teens standing scattered in the courtyard in front of the wing, and in the distance there were more than ten Tiansha gang members with knives standing there.
These young people gathered in groups of three or five. It was obvious that they, like Song Wen, were basically coerced to this point, and many of them were whispering their dissatisfaction.
These young people are all locals in Yancheng and know the strength of the Tiansha Gang. Although their hearts are full of anger and unwillingness, they can only point at the guards in a low voice and dare not speak out in anger.
Among them was a fat little man in gorgeous clothes, who stood out among the many young people who mostly came from poor backgrounds and were thin.
The little fat man roared angrily.
"You Tiansha Gang are so brave. You dare to kidnap me. My father, Zhang Erhe, is the magistrate of Qingyuan County. Why don't you send me back quickly!"
His refuting voice was loud, attracting the attention of everyone present.
Song Wen's eyes were also attracted by the little fat man.
Qingyuan County is a county under Yancheng, only a hundred miles away from Yancheng.
In Qian State, the power of a county magistrate is still very great.
Song Wen was curious, GodHow are the Sha Gang going to deal with this little fat man?
Is it that the little fat man is a stupid son of a landlord and cannot see the reality clearly; or is it that the Tiansha Gang made a mistake and hit the iron plate.
When the guards heard this, although there was hesitation in their eyes, they were unmoved. It was obviously not the first time that they heard the little fat man mention his identity. But the guard also found it a bit difficult to deal with the little fat man.
At this moment, a figure walked out from behind the guards.
The person who came was about forty years old, with a thin build and a mustache.
